title: Lavender Ledger — Stripe Payments Metrics
description: A two-column payments review slide modelled on Stripe's own dashboard language: a full-height MRR area chart anchors the left while three compact stat cards—each carrying a live delta badge and mini sparkline—stack on the right above a timestamped status footer. Inter type at three weights keeps hierarchy clinical.
philosophy: This template exists for the moment when revenue numbers must be legible in under three seconds, without a presenter narrating every line. It refuses decorative illustration, bespoke colour experiments, and anything that competes with the data itself. The soft lavender chart fill and binary green-rose delta system borrow directly from product-UI convention, signalling to a finance-literate room that what they are looking at is a live-data artefact, not a polished story deck. It is made for operators and investors, not for brand moments.
goodFor: Monthly MRR and gross volume reviews with seed-to-series investors
SaaS finance all-hands slides surfacing churn rate and ARPU side-by-side
Board-deck insert pages where a single metrics snapshot replaces a table
Weekly payments syncs where timestamp precision and currency context are required
avoidFor: Brand storytelling or narrative-first pitch decks
Slides carrying more than five simultaneous KPI streams
Creative agency or design portfolio presentations
Audiences unfamiliar with SaaS financial terminology such as ARPU or net-revenue churn
author: harness

examples.promptCore: The cover should feel like the title page of a live payments report — calm, operator-grade authority with zero narrative warmth or brand theatrics. A softly filled area-chart ghost on the right half implies data in suspension without exposing any individual value, creating quiet tension against the sparse, weight-contrast-only text on the left. Avoid decorative illustration, gradient drama, or any celebratory visual energy; the slide should be indistinguishable in mood from the product-UI artefact it references — precise, timestamped, and built for a room that will scrutinise every number.

examples.layoutNotes: 12-column grid; title and subtitle left-anchored in cols 1–8 with an 8% outer left margin and edge-to-edge bleed on the right half. A full-height muted area-chart silhouette occupies the right half as the primary visual mass, translating the template's live-data identity into a compositional hero element. Deck title sits in the upper-middle vertical zone with the review period or subtitle below it, separated by a single hairline rule. A flush-right reporting-period or company-context label anchors the bottom footer row; no decorative header band.

examples.promptCore: The slide reads as a live operational artefact — clinical, unsentimental, and built for a finance-literate room scanning for signal in under three seconds. The left area chart anchors the composition as a heavy data mass whose soft fill gives presence without spectacle, while the right column's modular card stack enables fast comparative scanning across KPIs. Delta badges function as binary health anchors, decisive and immediate, borrowing directly from product-UI convention to signal that numbers are live rather than curated. Avoid decorative illustration, gradient ornament, or any compositional softness that implies a story deck rather than an operator-grade data snapshot.

examples.layoutNotes: 12-column grid divides into a 7-col left panel and a 5-col right panel separated by a single hairline rule. The left panel holds a full-height MRR area chart that bleeds flush to the top and bottom content boundary, filling its column without padding. The right panel stacks three equal-height stat cards with tight inter-card gutters; each card holds a headline figure, a delta badge top-right, and a mini sparkline pinned to the card's lower edge. A full-width footer row at the slide base carries a timestamp and status indicator in a reduced weight, visually subordinate to all card content above it.
